title: Checkpoint: the unlabeled final
prompt:
No topic, no hints. A 'signal' array is one where every element from index 1 on is **strictly greater** than the previous element. Return the length of the longest contiguous signal segment; an empty array returns 0, a single element counts as a segment of 1.

Implement `process(int[] arr)`.

Example: `{5, 9, 2, 4, 6, 1}` → `3` (2,4,6).

tests.name: longest rising segment
tests.hint: Run counter resets when arr[i] <= arr[i-1]; track the max including the length-1 base.
